lobby.title: Meet in the courtyard
lobby.explanation: Create a room and share its invitation, or enter the code from your friend. Win three rounds to take the match.
lobby.codeHint: Use eight letters or digits from the invitation.

matchResult.roundWins: {{player}} wins the match with three round wins.
matchResult.abandoned: The match ended after both players left.

rematch.locked: Rematch opens after the result hold.
rematch.needsPlayers: Both players must be present for a rematch.

connection.disconnected: Choose how to enter a room.
connection.reconnecting: Restoring your place in the match…

reconnect.title: Connection interrupted
reconnect.retrying: The courtyard remains as you last saw it while your seat is restored. Controls will return after a fresh game state arrives.
reconnect.resultHeld: The next round will wait for both players to reconnect.

arena.label: Grenadiers courtyard
arena.failure: The courtyard could not be drawn. Leave the room and try again.
arena.focusHint: Select the courtyard to control your player.
arena.instructions: Move with {{movement}}. Place a bomb with {{bomb}}. Controls work only during a live round.

controls.title: Keyboard controls
controls.explanation: Choose Change, then press one physical key. Custom controls are saved in this browser.
controls.captureHint: Press an allowed key, or Escape to cancel. Tab still moves focus.
controls.unsupported: Use an arrow, letter, number, Space, or Enter without modifier keys.

error.title: Could not complete that action
error.connectionFailed: The game connection ended. Try again.
error.invalidServerMessage: The server sent game data this version cannot use.
error.sessionFailed: A game session could not be created. Try again.
error.sequenceExhausted: This connection reached its command limit. Start a new session.
error.incompatibleProtocol: This game version is not supported by the server.
error.invalidMessage: The server could not understand that command.
error.authenticationFailed: This game session is no longer valid.
error.connectionInUse: This session is already open elsewhere.
error.alreadyAuthenticated: This connection is already signed in.
error.roomNotFound: That room is no longer available.
error.staleRoom: The room changed before the command arrived.
error.staleSequence: That command arrived out of order.
error.duplicateAction: That bomb action was already received.
error.capacityReached: The server has no room for another match.
error.resumeRejected: This reserved seat is no longer available.
error.seatReplaced: This seat was resumed in another tab.
